summary: The sources reviewed through 2026-11-22 UTC yielded no author gene-level effects comparable to the registered isoflurane-versus-oxygen contrast in excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons or non-neuronal cells. GEO provides the count matrices used for the mouse-level analysis. The related GSE243489 supplements cover recovery sleep.

manualReview.summary: No comparable author effects located for isoflurane versus oxygen in the three registered preoptic populations
manualReview.note: GSE337822 contains 20 mice, with five females and five males per treatment arm. Its 180 sample files comprise 60 feature-by-nucleus count matrices with matching feature and barcode lists. The series matrix contains zero gene rows. The registered edgeR models compare isoflurane with oxygen within each broad population and adjust for sex. GEO describes responses within cell clusters. The accession, publication and repository searches through 2026-11-22 UTC located no author gene-level effects for the registered populations. GSE243489 supplied the cell taxonomy and compares recovery sleep with undisturbed sleep in a separate cohort.
reviewFlags: Author effect sizes, P values and FDR remain unassessed in excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons and non-neuronal cells.
